system.description: Rather than waiting for a creature to step on one of your Web Anchors, you force them to carry it with them. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack or deal [Weapon Damage] to them as a result of a Hijutsu you cast, you can mark them with Silk Tag. Creatures marked with this tag are treated as always occupying a space covered by your Web Anchor. This tag lasts until the end of your next turn before dissolving.
